The *Paccuppannānāgatavāra* is a leaf section within the *Yamaka*, the sixth book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. Designated as section Ya 10.3.5, it forms part of the temporal analysis in the tenth chapter of the *Yamaka*, applying the work's distinctive paired question-and-answer method to categories framed from the perspective of the present and future (*paccuppannānāgata*) [Catalog; SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. The largest sharing occurs with contiguous sections of the same chapter, notably *Anāgatavāra* (Ya 10.3.3; 331 matches, 78,465 characters), *Atītānāgatavāra* (Ya 10.3.6; 338 matches, 66,506 characters), *Paccuppannātītavāra* (Ya 10.3.4; 265 matches, 60,388 characters), *Paccuppannavāra* (Ya 10.3.1; 286 matches, 58,985 characters), and *Uppādavāra* (Ya 10.2.1; 375 matches, 42,280 characters) [DharmaNexus].
